resources.string: Prevent all apps and system services from accessing the camera hardware.
Prevent all apps and system services from accessing the microphone and recording audio.

This feature completely disables all USB data signaling, rendering the port incapable of any communication. All peripheral devices—including storage drives, keyboards, mice, and monitors—will be blocked. The port will function exclusively as an isolated charging interface, significantly enhancing protection against BadUSB-style attacks.
Your device hardware does not support this restriction.

Disables file sharing with other devices via USB. Please note that only file transfer protocols (MTP/PTP) are restricted; peripherals and connected accessories will continue to function normally. This setting does not provide protection against BadUSB attacks.
Completely prohibits the installation of applications from any source, including official app stores and manual package installations (sideloading).
Blocks the installation of third-party packages and manual sideloading. App installations via authorized stores are not affected.
Disables the ability to uninstall applications. All existing apps will be locked against deletion.
Blocks access to app settings, including force stopping, and storage clearing (data & cache).
Prevents your screen data from being used for AI-driven features and analysis.
Not available for your Android version

Prevents the system from suggesting actions or content based on what you select on your screen. This disables \"smart\" suggestions that analyze your current screen context to offer relevant links, apps, or information.
Prevents capturing the screen via screenshots or video recordings. This also blocks screen sharing and projection to external displays.

Enabling or accessing any debugging features, including USB Debugging, is prohibited. This restriction prevents all advanced developer actions, such as app installations via ADB, access to system logs, and direct service calls.
The ability to perform a factory reset is disabled.
Access to Safe Mode is blocked. This prevents bypassing security restrictions or disabling protection by starting the device in a limited state.
Creation of new user profiles on the device is prohibited.
Removal of secondary user profiles from the device is prohibited.
The ability to switch between different user accounts on the device is disabled.
Bluetooth is completely disabled. Turning on, using, or configuring Bluetooth connections via Settings is prohibited.
Bluetooth settings and device pairing via the Settings menu are disabled. This restriction does not prevent turning Bluetooth on or off and does not block the use of already paired devices.

Connecting and accessing physical external storage, such as USB drives or SD cards, is prohibited. The device will not mount or recognize any external media. This restriction applies only after a device restart.
